overview: You wrote one sentence and did not send it. You do not know the day of a Lent journey, and you will not write a yes to be rid of the question. Anne's letter was still open. Nothing went to the Bell.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Wrote the sentence and did not seal it.

assets.name: the Bell
assets.disposition: Wrote the Lent sentence on the open letter
